scheme_name: Phase-II Of The Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Programme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a residential consumer or a group housing society
Applicant must have an electricity connection in their own name and pay the electricity bill regularly
Applicant must obtain permission from the roof owner to install the solar rooftop system
Installation must be carried out by a vendor empaneled with the DISCOM
benefits_summary: Consumers receive a subsidy of 40% for systems up to 3 kW and 20% for larger capacities, with the subsidy directly credited to the vendor after inspection.
